Name: Hibernation
Author: Shockah
Description:
[size=6]TL;DR:[/size]
[size=4]Sleep through multiple nights at a time, or until specific days.[/size]

Adds an option to "hibernate" until several days later, or until a specific day - be it the next birthday, next festival, next season or next overnight event.
Additionally, you can cancel anytime by holding the Escape key.

The mod [b]DOES NOT WORK IN MULTIPLAYER[/b], and it's specifically disabled in that mode. Supporting multiplayer would require a lot of extra work, and I just don't have that kind of time right now.
The mod works by forcing the player to sleep instantly, while skipping saving until the very last night. This means it should be compatible with most of the mods. I didn't test this [i]too[/i] much, but I can at least say that [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url] works without any problems.
Should be compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10108]Longer Seasons[/url], although I did not test that personally.

[size=6]Configuration[/size]
The mod has some configurable intervals available in the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] file, but I deemed it not necessary to add [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] support at this moment. The default intervals are "3 days", "1 week", "1 season", "1 year", "5 years" and "forever".

[size=6]Other info[/size]
You can find the source code [url=https://github.com/Shockah/Stardew-Valley-Mods/tree/master/Hibernation]here[/url].
